Adds [Component name](https://github.com/owner/repository) to the 4D Corner list.

## Checklist

### `OfficialComponents.json`

- [ ] `title` is filled in with the component name
- [ ] `repository` is the URL of the component's repository
- [ ] `path_logo` is a direct URL to the image file, only if the icon is not in the root or `Resources` folder

### Repository

- [ ] Icon: `logo.svg` or `logo.png` in the root or `Resources` folder, and listed in the GitHub "Code" section
- [ ] GitHub description explains what the component does
- [ ] `4d-component` topic is added
- [ ] License file is present and the license is shown on the GitHub repository
- [ ] README gives installation steps, basic usage examples, and the key features and entry points

### Release

- [ ] The component is packaged as a ZIP named exactly like the repository (`myComponent` → `myComponent.zip`)
- [ ] The ZIP is uploaded as an asset of a GitHub Release
- [ ] The release tag uses semantic versioning (`majorVersion.minorVersion.patchNumber`)
